Is there anything I should pair it with to get the best result?

You do not need any extra device to use Oura Ring 5.

For the best experience, pair it with the Oura App on a compatible phone running iOS 16+ or Android 11+ with Google Play services, and make sure your device supports Bluetooth 5.0. Your ring will begin collecting data right away, and after at least one night of sleep you will start receiving Sleep and Readiness Scores in the app.
